The response usefully narrows the claim: rollout controls alone do not satisfy policy, and any defensible certification theory would require explicit disclosure of the exposed developer-support migration limitation plus monitoring. Because that predicate remains unmet in admissible evidence, this is not yet compliant_with_caveats; the caveat is the unresolved requirement itself. The packet therefore remains suspicious rather than compliant, while also not supporting a stronger noncompliant finding absent evidence that certification already proceeded without the required disclosure.
